Musk is widely regarded as a key figure in the 21st‑century technology landscape, influencing sectors such as automotive, space travel, energy storage, artificial intelligence, and infrastructure. Narendra Modi is an Indian politician who has served as the Prime Minister of India since May 26, 2014. He is the leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and was previously the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014. Modi’s tenure as prime minister has focused on economic reforms, infrastructure development, digital initiatives, and a range of domestic and foreign policy initiatives, including the “Make in India” campaign, the Goods and Services Tax (GST) implementation, and the “Swachh Bharat” cleanliness drive. He has also been a prominent figure in international diplomacy, engaging with leaders from around the world on issues such as climate change, trade, and global security.
